subject: Q4 Budget Review Meeting Tomorrow
body:
Hi team,

Reminder that we have the Q4 budget review meeting tomorrow at 2pm in Conference Room A.

Please bring your department reports and be prepared to discuss:
- Current spend vs. budget
- Q1 projections
- Any capital expenditure requests

Looking forward to seeing everyone there.

Best,
John
